papers.title: Epidemiology-informed graph neural networks for predicting and interpreting transmissible hospital-acquired infections
papers.study_type: Dynamic contact-network graph neural network; one real-world hospital-onset COVID-19 cohort and two simulated HAI datasets
papers.key_result: Epidemiology-informed GNN jointly predicts patient infection state transitions and estimates transmission/recovery parameters; reported AUC-ROC up to 98.46% across datasets/settings. External prospective clinical effectiveness not established.
papers.verification_scope: publisher abstract, DOI and online date
papers.relevance: ICU infections, mechanistic constraints, interpretable patient state transitions; method transferable to perioperative digital twin but not an anesthesia validation
